plan.title: Recreate Order Rejects Past Delivery Date

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ rather than creating or searching for another event.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled as required by the case.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu and launch the Recreate Order dialog.
Verify that the Recreate Order pop-up opened.
Attempt to set the delivery date to yesterday.
Verify that creating the order is refused when the delivery date is in the past.
